description: The Global Configuration keys the Network Monitor reads (architecture §2.3, implementation §1.2.5, §5). Durations are integers in milliseconds.

quality_window.description: How many of the node's last closes, among those within evidence_staleness, its quality and cost signals are computed over (architecture §3.12.1).

min_observations.description: How many observations a signal needs before it is actionable (architecture §3.12.1).

evidence_staleness.description: How old, in wall-clock time, an observation can be and still enter a window, in milliseconds (architecture §3.12.1).

grace_period.description: How much admission_clock passes after a task.completed before it is classified clean, in milliseconds (architecture §3.12.1).

score_floor.description: The quality constraint of the network's objective function: score ≥ score_floor (architecture §3.12.2).

outer_share.description: The fraction of the quality_window tasks, those with the lowest similarity to the node, that forms the outer group of the radial axis (architecture §3.12.2).

usage_window.description: How many of the last assignments granted on the node's topic the usage signals are computed over (architecture §3.12.2).

review_emission_rate.description: How many node_review an instance emits per hour at most in its partition (architecture §3.12.1).

exploration_share.description: The fraction of review_emission_rate reserved for routine reviews (architecture §3.12.1).

w1.description: The weight of reopen_rate in the score: score = 1 − clamp(w1·reopen_rate, 0, 1) (implementation §5.1).

max_idle_share.description: The idle_share above which low_usage triggers (implementation §5.4).

no_demand_retention.description: How much admission_clock passes without an assignment on a topic before no_demand triggers on its nodes, in milliseconds (implementation §5.5).

cost_drift_threshold.description: By how much the cost_own_p50 of the current window exceeds that of the previous one when high_cost triggers (implementation §5.2).

duration_drift_threshold.description: By how much the duration_p50 of the current window exceeds that of the previous one when high_latency triggers (implementation §5.2).

outer_reopen_threshold.description: By how much reopen_rate_outer exceeds reopen_rate_inner when outer_gradient triggers (implementation §5.3).

outer_cost_threshold.description: By how much cost_own_p50_outer exceeds cost_own_p50_inner, as a ratio, when outer_gradient triggers (implementation §5.3).

outer_duration_threshold.description: By how much duration_p50_outer exceeds duration_p50_inner, as a ratio, when outer_gradient triggers (implementation §5.3).
